messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH severity alert — continuous-batching queue tail latency > 1s for 3m on prod-us-west. KV cache eviction rate spike x12. Pager: oncall jen. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/CB-1884005678
jen: Ack — paging in. Looking now. Anyone already triaged?
sam: I see inflow ramp from tenant 'alpha' ~3x baseline. microbatch sizes spiking to max_microbatch_size=64 in the batcher logs. KV cache eviction lagging behind. Might be synchronized batching.
luca: Correlating traces: lots of near-simultaneous cold KV lookups for same prefix -> eviction pressure. batching_jitter_ms is 0 across the fleet (weird).
jen: If jitter is off, requests synchronize, big microbatches form, then we sweep the KV cache -> eviction storm -> disk fallback -> latency cliff. Makes sense.
maria: Customer impact snapshot: about 7% of requests >5s in sampled traces; 2% 503 errors concentrated to a few tenants (alpha included). Could breach SLO if not mitigated.
jen: Mitigation plan (short): 1) re-enable batching_jitter to 20ms, 2) reduce max_microbatch_size from 64 -> 16, 3) enable prefix-level KV admission throttle to limit eviction storms. Will canary the runtime flag change and edge-rate-limit alpha.
kevin: I can add an edge-level soft throttle on tenant alpha to ding it to 60% for 5m while we stabilize. Want me to proceed?
jen: Yes, do that. I'll push runtime toggles to canary pods first. Alex, please prepare rollback steps if we regress.
alex: On it. Rollback plan ready: revert flags and re-open traffic.
jen: Pushing hotfix now to runtime API.
jen: ```
# toggle flags via runtime API
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\\\n  https://runtime-api.prod.redwood.internal/v1/flags \\\\n  -d '{\n    \"service\":\"batcher\",\n    \"flags\":{\n      \"batching_jitter_ms\":20,\n      \"max_microbatch_size\":16,\n      \"kv_prefix_admission\":\"throttle\"\n    }\n  }'\n```
sam: Canary pods (batcher-rc-12) picked up the flags. Observed microbatch sizes trending 12-16, jitter ~18-22ms. KV eviction rate down ~70% in 30s.
jen: Rolling to 30% of fleet.
kevin: Edge throttle applied for alpha -> 60% traffic for 5m.
maria: Early metrics: alpha org error rate down 2.3% -> 0.4%, p95 latency 900ms -> 220ms after edge+canary changes.
luca: Note: smaller microbatches increase per-token work; cost impact expected but acceptable for now. We'll optimize later.
jen: If metrics hold 6m, roll to full fleet. Proceeding unless objections.
alex: Proceed. Monitoring dashboard live.
jen: Rolling to 100% now.
sam: Hotfix applied cluster-wide. median microbatch ~14, jitter ~20ms, KV eviction back to baseline. No new 503 spikes in last 3m.
maria: Drafting customer-facing note: \"We've applied mitigations to stabilize inference. Some tenants may see slight cost changes while we tune defaults.\" I'll post with ops-approved wording.
jen: Root cause summary: batching_jitter disabled + sudden high concurrency from a single tenant caused synchronized microbatch formation -> large microbatches -> KV cache eviction storms -> latency and 503s. Fixes we applied: re-enable jitter default, reduce max_microbatch_size to safer default, enable per-prefix admission throttle, and apply tenant-level inflow guardrails.
luca: Follow-ups: implement adaptive microbatch sizing (scale microbatch by current concurrency and cache hit rates) and staggered request windows for high-fanout prefixes.
jen: Action items assigned: LUCA -> CB-456 implement adaptive sizing, SAM -> CB-457 tenant inflight limiter and playbook, ALEX -> CB-458 observability QA and alert tuning, MARIA -> customer comms, KEVIN -> edge-rate-limit runbook update.
jen: Handoff: I'll be off in 20m. Next oncall is alex. @alex take lead for monitoring and any escalations. I'll be reachable for 30m after handoff.
alex: Ack — taking handoff. Will monitor for 30m and escalate to daytime oncall if needed. :white_check_mark: 
maria: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 1884005725 after mitigations held. I'll update the ticket and comms.
kevin: Nice work team — quick mitigation. :raised_hands: 
incident-bot: Incident CB-2026-1884005678 created and annotated. Status: mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline recorded: 1884005678..1884005735.
jen: Thanks everyone, good job. :thumbsup:
